headword: {旧約聖書|きゅうやくせいしょ}

definitions.explanation: The first and larger of the two main divisions of the Christian Bible, containing the scriptures inherited from Judaism: the books of Moses, historical books, prophets, and wisdom literature. The Japanese name literally means 'the scripture of the old covenant,' contrasting with {新約聖書|しんやくせいしょ} ('New Testament').

examples.japanese: {旧約聖書|きゅうやくせいしょ}を{読|よ}んでいる。
{旧約聖書|きゅうやくせいしょ}の{物語|ものがたり}を{子供|こども}に{聞|き}かせた。
examples.english: She told stories from the Old Testament to her children.

examples.japanese: {旧約聖書|きゅうやくせいしょ}の{創世記|そうせいき}には、{世界|せかい}の{成|な}り{立|た}ちが{書|か}かれている。
examples.english: Genesis in the Old Testament describes the origin of the world.

examples.japanese: {旧約聖書|きゅうやくせいしょ}は、キリスト{教|きょう}だけでなくユダヤ{教|きょう}の{聖典|せいてん}でもある{点|てん}で{重要|じゅうよう}だ。
examples.english: The Old Testament is important in that it is a sacred text not only of Christianity but also of Judaism.

notes:
Compound of {旧約|きゅうやく} ('old covenant') and {聖書|せいしょ} ('scripture; Bible'). The term {旧約|きゅうやく} refers to the covenant between God and Israel established through Moses, which Christians see as superseded — though not abolished — by the {新約|しんやく} ('new covenant') brought by Jesus.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {旧約聖書|きゅうやくせいしょ}を{読|よ}む: to read the Old Testament
- {旧約聖書|きゅうやくせいしょ}の{創世記|そうせいき}: Genesis (book of the Old Testament)
- {旧約聖書|きゅうやくせいしょ}の{預言者|よげんしゃ}: prophets of the Old Testament
- {旧約聖書|きゅうやくせいしょ}の{物語|ものがたり}: stories from the Old Testament
- {旧約聖書|きゅうやくせいしょ}の{世界|せかい}: the world of the Old Testament

WELL-KNOWN BOOKS:
- {創世記|そうせいき}: Genesis
- {出|しゅつ}エジプト{記|き}: Exodus
- {詩篇|しへん}: Psalms
- {箴言|しんげん}: Proverbs
- イザヤ{書|しょ}: Book of Isaiah

USAGE:
- A standard term used in religious, historical, and literary contexts. In academic writing it also refers to the Hebrew Bible (Tanakh), though the two have slightly different book orders and canon.
- Often contrasted in a pair with {新約聖書|しんやくせいしょ}: {旧約聖書|きゅうやくせいしょ}と{新約聖書|しんやくせいしょ} ('the Old and New Testaments').
- Commonly abbreviated as {旧約|きゅうやく} when context makes the 'Bible' part clear, e.g., {旧約|きゅうやく}の{物語|ものがたり} ('Old Testament stories').

RELATED WORDS:
- {新約聖書|しんやくせいしょ}: New Testament
- {聖書|せいしょ}: Bible; scripture (general)
- {聖典|せいてん}: sacred text; scripture (of any religion)
- キリスト{教|きょう}: Christianity
- ユダヤ{教|きょう}: Judaism
